SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS d,
 MIN(order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND status <> 'cancelled'
),
t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) AS orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM o) AS distinct_orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) AS test_orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line)) AS no_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) ) AS check_total,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_web_order_load WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') AS stg

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') AS utc_day,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') AS helsinki_day,
       COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS total_distinct
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-27' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30'
